## This work (Р-191)

The Pulp Cthulhu import (Р-183) left candidates: things the book names, with numbers or text, that have no record. Make them records, then link the records that mention them. Source of the list: the sections «Кандидаты…» of `checks/20261108-pulp/villains.md`, `disintegrator.md`, `magic-running.md`, `organizations.md`, `slowboat.md`, `hurricane.md`, `system-sanity.md` — read them first, and read the book pages for every candidate (`python pipeline/source/pages.py grep pulp-cthulhu-en "<English name>"`, then `show`).

- Before creating, search the base (`Grep` in `kb/`, `python tools/terms.py <word>`): if a record already exists under another name (a Grand Grimoire spell with an alias, a weapon position with another calibre name), do not duplicate — link it and say so in the coverage. `coc:spell:gate-boxes` has the alias «Vanish» from the Grand Grimoire, but the Pulp Cthulhu spell «Vanish» is another spell: make it a new record and note the difference in both (proposal for gate-boxes).
- Global kinds (spell, weapon, talent) are `coc:<kind>:<slug>` in `kb/<kinds>/<slug>.json`, slug from the English name; `axes.ruleset: "pulp"`, `axes.era: ["1930s"]` unless the book says otherwise; sources — pages of `pulp-cthulhu-en`. A book's own unique thing (a tome that exists only in this book) is book-scoped: `pulp-cthulhu-en/tome/<slug>` in `kb/books/pulp-cthulhu-en/tomes/`.
- A spell the book only names, without any text (Summon/Bind Star Spawn of Cthulhu, Summon/Bind Flying Polyp), is not made: link the family `coc:spell:summon-bind` (exists) — say so in the coverage.
- A unique weapon of one villain (a named dagger, a death ray) is still a `weapon` position if it has weapon numbers (skill, damage, range, attacks, ammo, malfunction); its owner is linked from the weapon (`refs`) and the owner's `statblock.attacks[].weapon` points to it. Missing columns stay null as printed (`—` is shown by the viewer).
- Edits of records that exist (characters, organizations, items, rules, other spells) go only through proposals `checks/20261108-pulp/proposals-candidates-<unit>.json` (format: `pipeline/integrate/README.md`), e.g. a character's attack gets `weapon`, a rule's text mention gets `refs`, a talent gets `refs` to a new spell. Do not edit files you do not own.
- English book: Russian text is our translation (`translated`); look every term up first (`python tools/terms.py <word>`, accepted terms as is), the English name goes to `name.en`.
- Coverage: `checks/20261108-pulp/candidates-<unit>.md` — each candidate → record made / linked to an existing one / not made with the reason.
